title: 6 – REQUIREMENTS FOR INSTITUTIONAL, PUBLIC ASSEMBLY, RESIDENTIAL, AND COMMERCIAL OCCUPANCIES
officialText: 6.2.4 Delete the words, "more than 1 pound" and substitute: "more than 6 lbs." Add the following to the end of this paragraph: "Electric hot plates and bunsen burners used intermittently shall not be considered a violation of this paragraph provided that the number of bunsen burners installed shall not exceed one burner for each 3 lbs. of refrigerant in the system."
